name: Munchausen + Online/Target Ensemble
tagline: Standard linear Q head trained with Munchausen-augmented rewards (target net log-policy bonus) and 0.5/0.5 online+target Q for action selection.
formula:
$$ \pi_{\bar\theta}(a|s) = \mathrm{softmax}\!\big(Q_{\bar\theta}(s,\cdot)/\tau\big), \quad r' = r + \alpha \tau\,\mathrm{clip}\!\big(\log\pi_{\bar\theta}(a|s),\,-1,\,0\big) $$
$$ y = r' + \gamma(1-d)\max_{a'} Q_{\bar\theta}(s', a'),\;\; \mathcal{L} = \mathrm{MSE}(Q_\theta(s,a), y) $$
$$ a_{\text{select}} = \arg\max_a 0.5\,Q_\theta(s,a) + 0.5\,Q_{\bar\theta}(s,a) $$

key_hyperparams.name: ensemble_mix
key_hyperparams.role: online vs target weights at action selection

init_recovers: vanilla DQN at α=0 and ensemble mix={1,0}
diff_from_baseline: Replaces the placeholder algorithm with Munchausen-DQN: augments rewards by α·τ·clip(log π_target(a|s)) using the target network's softmax policy, keeps the same linear Q head, uses 50/50 online+target ensemble for action selection, and trains with MSE TD loss + grad-norm clip 10.

name: 5-head Ensemble + UCB Action + Pessimistic Target
tagline: Five linear Q heads on shared encoder; UCB action selection (mean+β·std), pessimistic max target (mean-β·std), variance-weighted Huber TD loss.
formula:
$$ Q_k(s,a),\,k=1..5;\;\; \bar Q = \tfrac{1}{5}\sum_k Q_k,\;\; s_Q = \sqrt{\mathrm{Var}_k Q_k} $$
$$ a_{\text{select}} = \arg\max_a \bar Q(s,a) + \beta s_Q(s,a) $$
$$ y = \mathrm{clip}\big(r + \gamma(1-d)\,\max_{a'} (\bar Q_{\bar\theta} - \beta s_{Q,\bar\theta})(s',a'),\,-1000,\,1000\big) $$
$$ w_i = \tfrac{1}{1+\sqrt{\mathrm{Var}_k Q_k(s_i,a_i)+\varepsilon}}, \quad \mathcal{L} = \overline{w_i \cdot \mathrm{Huber}_{10}(Q_k(s_i,a_i) - y_i)} $$

key_hyperparams.name: head_init
key_hyperparams.role: small random heads to break symmetry

init_recovers: single-head DQN when ensemble_size=1 and β=0
diff_from_baseline: Compared to the dueling/QR/C51 baselines, builds a 5-head ensemble on the shared encoder, uses UCB (mean+β·std) for action selection and pessimism (mean-β·std) for the bootstrap target, and trains every head with a per-sample inverse-uncertainty-weighted Huber-10 TD loss.

name: Dueling + Munchausen Soft-Q Target
tagline: Dueling Q head trained with Munchausen entropy-regularized soft-Q targets and a smooth-L1 TD loss.
formula:
$$ Q(s,a) = V(s) + A(s,a) - \overline{A(s,\cdot)}, \quad \pi_\theta(a|s) = \mathrm{softmax}(Q/\tau),\;\; \log\pi_\theta(a|s) $$
$$ V_{soft}(s') = \sum_{a'} \pi_{\bar\theta}(a'|s')\big(Q_{\bar\theta}(s',a') - \tau \log\pi_{\bar\theta}(a'|s')\big) $$
$$ y = r + \alpha\tau\,\mathrm{clip}(\log\pi_\theta(a|s),-1,0) + \gamma(1-d)V_{soft}(s'),\;\; \mathcal{L} = \mathrm{SL1}(Q(s,a), y) $$

key_hyperparams.name: log_pi_clip
key_hyperparams.role: clamp on log π in reward bonus

init_recovers: dueling_dqn baseline when α=0 and τ→∞ (V_soft → max)
diff_from_baseline: Combines the dueling_dqn architecture with a Munchausen-DQN soft target: bootstrap uses V_soft(s') = E_π[Q − τ log π] from the target net's softmax policy, and the reward is augmented by α·τ·clip(log π_θ(a|s), -1, 0); TD loss is Smooth-L1.

name: Dueling + Double + Advantage-Variance Reg
tagline: Dueling Double-DQN with a per-action 'uncertainty' = centered-advantage^2, scheduled penalty applied only to the chosen action, plus target consistency.
formula:
$$ Q(s,a) = V(s) + (A(s,a) - \overline{A(s,\cdot)}),\;\; U(s,a) = (A(s,a) - \overline{A(s,\cdot)})^2 $$
$$ \beta(t) = 0.08 + \min(t/250{,}000, 1)\cdot(0.01 - 0.08) $$
$$ a^\* = \arg\max_{a'} \big(Q_\theta - \beta U_\theta\big)(s',a'),\;\; y = r + \gamma(1-d)\,Q_{\bar\theta}(s', a^\*) $$
$$ \mathcal{L} = \mathrm{SL1}(Q_\theta(s,a), y) + \beta\,\overline{\sigma(Q_\theta - y)\,U_\theta(s,a)} + 0.05\,\mathrm{SL1}(Q_\theta(s,a), Q_{\bar\theta}(s,a)) $$
init_recovers: Dueling Double-DQN when β=0 and consistency_coef=0
diff_from_baseline: Compared to dueling_dqn it (a) adds Double-DQN bootstrapping with the online net's argmax computed under (Q − βU), (b) defines an action-wise 'uncertainty' U from squared centered advantages, (c) adds an adaptive sigmoid(optimism)·U penalty on the chosen action with annealed β, and (d) adds a 0.05·SL1 consistency term against the target network's Q for (s,a).
